language.title: Language
language.footer: Choose the language used across the phone interface.

stt_model.slower_sub: Better accuracy and intent capture, especially outside English; heavier CPU/RAM and longer waits.
stt_model.faster_sub: Quicker answers. Meaning and recognition quality drop more for languages other than English.

toggles.enable_subtitle: Push-to-talk voice commands when the Aura add-on is installed.
toggles.global_peek_subtitle: Hold the Aura key (default B) to open a peek strip and listen, even if the phone UI was closed. Requires Aura add-on.
toggles.lock_screen_subtitle: Allow limited voice commands while locked (call, camera, flashlight). Turn off to block Aura on the lock screen.

peek_lock_policy.title: Peek & lock rules
peek_lock_policy.detail: Peek (global hotkey strip): only calling and flashlight. Locked phone (not unlocked): call, open Camera, flashlight — other commands ask you to unlock. Peek + locked: camera is blocked too. Disable lock-screen Aura in Settings if you want no voice while locked.

brightness_volume.title: Brightness & volume
brightness_volume.detail: Set absolute level or nudge: “Set brightness to 50”, “volume 30”, “brighter”, “quieter”. Turkish phrases like “parlaklığı yüzde 40 yap” also work. Not available in peek or on the lock screen until you unlock.

music_media.title: Music & media
music_media.detail: “Play”, “pause”, “next track”, “previous song”, and similar short media commands.

flashlight.title: Flashlight
flashlight.detail: “Turn flashlight on/off”, “torch”, quick on/off intents. Allowed in peek and on the lock screen.

open_app.title: Open apps
open_app.detail: Say open/launch/start plus the app name. The list below shows every app Aura may open on this build. On a locked phone only Camera is allowed (not in peek). Other apps require unlock.

wifi_cellular_orientation.title: Wi‑Fi, cellular, rotation lock
wifi_cellular_orientation.detail: Control Center style toggles: Wi‑Fi, mobile data, orientation lock — short imperative phrases.

audio_output.title: Audio output
audio_output.detail: Switch between phone speaker and earbuds when supported, e.g. “use speaker”, “play on earbuds”.

call_contact.title: Call someone
call_contact.detail: “Call John”, “phone Mom” — uses your contacts when the assistant resolves the name. Allowed in peek and on the lock screen.

send_message.title: Send a message
send_message.detail: Message someone: with text, Aura sends it and opens the chat; without text, it only opens the chat so you can type.

cc_toggles.title: Quick settings toggles
cc_toggles.detail: Airplane mode, Bluetooth, silent mode, dark mode, streamer mode, hidden number, battery percentage, game time clock, Face ID — short on/off phrases. Requires unlock (not in peek / not on lock screen).

slider_followup.title: Follow-up for sliders
slider_followup.detail: After changing brightness or volume, short phrases like “a bit more” can adjust the same target for a short time.

llm_fallback.title: Natural language & fallback
llm_fallback.detail: When a phrase does not match the fast path, Aura may ask the add-on model. If the model output is invalid, you hear a short fallback hint.

toggles.motion_animations_subtitle: Smooth motion when opening apps and switching screens

optimization.info: If the phone feels laggy, try Performance mode or turn off interface animations. Screens will change instantly instead of sliding or fading. These settings are stored on this device.
